[8:45PM] #AjasaCommand #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is smooth along Ishefun, Ayobo, Megida.
Good at Amule, Oluwaganitoto, Church Roundabout, Adefemi-Fafunwa-Oju Odo Ikola, and Command.
However, expect slow movement at Ekoro junction due to alternation, Agbelekale-Ekoro junction, and Jubilee bridge is slow due to commercial activities. Traffic is steady at Ile Epo-Iyana Merian-Joke Ayo. Officers are on ground managing the situation.
